notes: W2R Open RFFE probe firmware. Clean-room, MIT-licensed replacement for the vendor's rffe-esp32-1.0.1.bin. Application partition only; the bootloader, partition table and boot_app0 come from the Arduino ESP32 core. This is the Arduino export's .ino.bin, which is flashed at 0x10000. Build from firmware/rffe-probe with PlatformIO (pio run).
